ackList.detail: Task 1 Claim — "A boot sim never reads a renderer file the host installed" — on the sandbox class that produced the red baseline (a plugin-target box where `fleet/setup-script.mjs` really installed the host renderer file) — This box carries no host renderer file (reading `/etc/fleet/render.env` here returns "File does not exist"), so the driver's green runs exercise the fix only against the exam's synthetic stand-in: `fleet/tests/test_sandbox_boot_render_env.mjs:152-161` writes its own file in a temp root and names it through `process.env.FLEET_RENDER_ENV`. The mechanism is fully pinned here — `<ctx.home>/systemd-run.env` shows one `FLEET_RENDER_ENV=` line and it is `renderEnvPath(ctx)`, so the script's `${FLEET_RENDER_ENV:-…}` fallback at `fleet/sandbox-boot.sh:72` is never reached — but the plan's own live reading (Context: "the baseline is green again on a plugin-target run with `render` set is a live fact for the PR body, not a `Run:` here") is the part this environment cannot present. [structural false-green: sandbox could not execute it against the target]
